name: Kiritimati (Christmas Island)
introduction: Kiritimati, also known as Christmas Island, is one of the largest coral atolls on Earth by land area and sits far from South Tarawa in the Line Islands, closer to Hawai'i than to the Gilbert Islands group. It is internationally known among anglers for its flats fishing and among birders for its seabird colonies.
geography: Kiritimati's land area is dominated by a vast lagoon system and extensive flats, with the main settlement of London serving as the island's hub.
practicalNotes: Kiritimati has its own international and domestic air links, separate from the Gilbert Islands' internal network, given the distance involved.
